$comment: Elementor CSS IDs on alpha.school campus pages that the n8n workflow 'Update school pages' writes from HubSpot Programs. A hand edit to any of these is overwritten on the next daily run. Derived from the field map in spec/content-pipelines.json (export inspected 2026-09-09) and confirmed present on live pages 2026-09-15 (Plano, Raleigh, Atlanta). Used by the Alpha WordPress MCP batch runner (--synced-targets) to refuse edits and by tests/page-check.mjs to detect a layout that dropped an ID. Confirm with the n8n-sync-owner; see the open question in content-pipelines.
overrideRule: Renaming an element's CSS ID with the suffix hides it from the workflow. Only under the recorded override procedure (APEX ticket, element, temporary value, owner, restore condition). Raleigh address-disabled is the live example.

synced.title: school name, city, state -> hero title; also SEO and social titles
synced.address: school_address -> address description; grade levels -> address title
synced.content_title: website copy with region, city, name substitutions

unconfirmed.campus: present on every page; owner unknown
unconfirmed.map: map embed; address may drive it
unconfirmed.events: events section wrapper; events_top_title and events_subtitle were dropped from the flow 2025-12-10
unconfirmed.content_heading_1: present on Raleigh and Atlanta; not in the 2026-09-09 map
unconfirmed.content_image: intro card image slot; believed manual
